g.text: What is trained, and what is only tested
Training and best_capture.pt use Hard only, scored by physical capture. Medium is the easier held-out test. Severe and Extreme are harder held-out tests.
Hard keeps the 12 m lidar while raising speed, occlusion, and start distance. Nominal is easier. Severe shortens lidar to 11 m. Extreme stays a held-out test.
Reward: time cost, visibility shaping, a potential on the physical gap of the second-closest body, +100 on the first physical capture, −50 on timeout.
Kept methods: APF, FRPN, MPC, A6 (HGAT-MATD3), MAPPO+. Ablation: MAPPO with the earlier DAgger retention. A0–A5 are not retrained.
